comments.author: @merlinathrawes746
comments.text: Love that you showed a shot of Fantastic Caverns, America's only ride-thru caves.  It's located just outside of Springfield, Missouri.  Silver Dollar City is just outside of Branson, Missouri.  Fun rides set in an old time atmosphere.  But all of Branson is an interesting experience with live theater shows for any taste as well as museums and shopping.  I would add one more stop.  Near Lampe, Missouri is Dogwood Canyon, a beautiful scenic area with a river running thru it, waterfalls, ponds full of fish, trails for hiking and biking, as well as tours with areas full of longhorn cattle, bison and elk.
